b: ^Tere. Sa vaatad maad nagu keegi, kes tahab midagi leida.
^en: Hello. You look at the ground like somebody who wants to find something.
^Ma olen siin kogu elu olnud. Küsi.
^en: I've been here all my life. Ask.

menu: ^Kaev on veel alles. %% The well is still here.
^Mida siit otsida oleks? %% What would there be to look for here?
^Värav põllu serval. %% The gate at the field's edge.
^Vana raamatu juures on midagi. %% There is something by the old book.
^Kivi maamärgi juures. %% The stone by the landmark.
^Mis koht see on? %% What is this place?

c-0: ^Magus vesi. Vanad ütlesid, et see oleks peaaegu täis aetud. Keegi aitas.
^en: Sweet water. The old people said it was nearly filled in. Somebody helped.
c-1: ^Ta ei loe seda kohe. Ta hoiab seda.
^en: They do not read it at once. They hold it.
^„Esimesest lõikusest.“ Ma tundsin käekirja ära enne, kui lugesin.
^en: "From the first harvest." I knew the hand before I read it.
^Kast on kõige vanema puu all. Ma oleksin pidanud arvama.
^en: The box is under the oldest tree. I should have guessed.
c-2: ^Ema ütles, et ta kirjutas kõik üles. Ma ei leidnud seda kunagi.
^en: Mother said she wrote it all down. I never found it.
c-3: ^Kolm puud kannavad veel. Igal sügisel vähem. Aga kannavad.
^en: Three trees still bear. Fewer every autumn. But they bear.
c-4: ^Piir on kirjas. Alati oli. Sellepärast värav veel seisab.
^en: The boundary is written. Always was. That is why the gate still stands.
c-5: ^Jah. Vasktükk. Ma ei tea, kelle oma. Nimi on peal, aga mitte meie oma.
^en: Yes. A piece of copper. I don't know whose. There is a name on it, but not ours.
c-6: ^Keegi pani selle sinna ammu. Nimi on veel peal. Meie omad hoidsid seda puhtana.
^en: Somebody set it there long ago. The name is still on it. Our people kept it clean.
c-8: ^Kvissentali. Kõik, mis siin on, seisab millegi vanema peal.
^en: Kvissentali. Everything here stands on something older.

sit: ^Noh. Räägime siis sellest, mis alles on.
^en: Well. Let's talk about what's still here.
